title: Template:Category/doc
content: ;Description :This template may be placed on any category page, to encourage users to help populate that category. ''(Note, it will not say [[Category:Category]] there - it will use the local category name.)'' ;Syntax :To use the template, type a short description of the category (unless its name is self-explanatory) followed by {{t|category}}.
